|lore=
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Booster's Star Destroyer (V)]] and the current text; the card was retitled with it (the game text did not change). The images are the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-45-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-errantventure-pre.gif]]), which print it. The original is [[Booster's Star Destroyer (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Booster's Star Destroyer (V)]]): printed as “•Booster's Star Destroyer (V)” on the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012), p. 8<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, and listed under that title, with the same text, on the PC website card list from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-old-errant">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]; Virtual Master list (VMasterType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “May add 6 pilots. Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. Unless your [Reflections II] objective on table, once per game may ▼ a non-[Maintenance] scoundrel aboard and while Corran or a Terrik piloting, immune to attrition < 7.” (The sheet's heading over the slip reads “•Booster's Star Destroyer (V)”; the card's own title bar has no “(V)”.) The card list spells out the ▼ (“may deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, icon notation only) and adds a comma after “once per game”; that comma alone waits for a ruling, so it is not a separate version.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the title changed to “•Errant Venture”; the game text did not change. The PC website card list shows the new title by 13 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-new-errant">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130313222931/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-03-13], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429063548/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-04-29]; VMasterType, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314003713/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-03-14], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429102413/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-04-29] (Internet Archive; these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, PDF page 49)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints the card as •Errant Venture. The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-45-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-errantventure-pre.gif]], undated) print it.
|hatnote=For the original printing (as Booster's Star Destroyer), see [[Booster's Star Destroyer (V)]].
